translation_snapshot.source: A huge and muscular orc of unknown breed. He looks both menacing and cunning...
translation_snapshot.target: 一只膘肥身健的巨大兽人。他看起来既危险又狡猾……

translation_snapshot.source: This ring is imbued with powers from beyond the grave. It is said that those who wear it may find a new path when all other roads turn dim.
translation_snapshot.target: 这枚戒指充溢着坟墓的气息。据说佩戴它的人会在走投无路时发现新的道路。

translation_snapshot.source: Back and Back and Back to the Future
